observations: Red Triumph scrambler motorcycle with gold front forks.
Black seat with a white circular badge on the side.
Black rear fender and black rear tire.
Gold front forks and black front fender.
Single round headlight with a chrome bezel.
Rear disc brake with a black brake rotor.
The Triumph logo is visible on the fuel tank in photo 0 and photo 2.
The motorcycle is parked on gravel with other motorcycles and cars in the background.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI E-GLE MOTORS' is present on all photos.

No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may not start or run.
risks.proof: A video of the engine starting and running.

risks.risk: The engine may be seized or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine cranking over and the motorcycle moving under load.

risks.risk: The rear suspension may be damaged or stiff.
risks.proof: A video showing the rear wheel being pushed and the fork moving freely.

risks.risk: The clutch may be worn or slipping.
risks.proof: A video of the clutch being engaged and the engine running smoothly.

risks.risk: The fuel tank may be cracked or leaking.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the fuel tank interior and a video of the tank being filled.

proof_requests: Video of the motorcycle starting and running.
Video of the engine cranking over and the motorcycle moving.
Video of the rear suspension being tested.
Close-up photo of the fuel tank interior.
Photo of the engine and transmission area.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Triumph scrambler motorcycle from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case (not working) until further proof is provided.
